purpose: Measure v11 and v13 mixed-tail Deform-only, Raster-only and Both on real Graph-qualified inputs.
device: Jetson AGX Orin sm_87, 16 SM, 1.3005 GHz
workload: flame_steak iteration 14000 test split, 1352x1014, 111525 Deform rows
inputs: Last two steady mixed pairs from a 5-frame Graph-qualified renderer extraction; same frozen inputs for both versions and all three modes.
arm_order: v11 Deform/Raster/Both then v13 Deform/Raster/Both on even rounds; reverse all six arms on odd rounds
graph_backend: CUDA Driver cuGraphInstantiateWithFlags=8 USE_NODE_PRIORITY, one kernel per replay, priority 0
timing: Unprofiled CUDA Event start/replay/end, precreated events; arithmetic mean of equally weighted independent process means.
kernel_control: Same runtime-selected diagnostic symbol per version; preserves production device math, work mapping, grid, block, register/shared envelope and launch bounds. No clock64 instrumentation.
correctness: Enabled Raster/Deform outputs poisoned before replay then checked bitwise against production; disabled outputs must remain NaN. Production references must be bitwise equal across versions. Hash frozen functional inputs/outputs across processes.
audits: Fresh nvidia-smi, memory, process, tegrastats and frequency checks before and after every process; continuous process/frequency sampling; sealed extraction and binary/source stability; inspect graph nodes and compiled function attributes.
scope: Hot isolated mixed-tail microbenchmark; excludes v13 prepass, feature prefix, preparation, allocation, weight packing, extraction, compilation and capture. Not full-frame FPS.
production_control: Separate unmodified production-symbol Graph measurement for each version and input after primary timings.
excluded_attempts: Initial copy attempt omitted inaccessible history results by moving to a fresh runtime. run0 failed before renderer workload execution due to an input-capture hook name; it contributes no timing samples. Completed run1/run2/run3 are the three admitted processes.
